authority_citations: ADR-SAG-0004 v3 (locked, kind prohibition): No sc-agent crate's Cargo.toml may depend on a crate in a higher layer, where the layers from the bottom are: types; config, secrets and log; http; decision schema; decision backends (sc-decision-llm over sc-llm-provider); runner. Scope: adds or changes a crate dependency in a Cargo.toml.
ADR-SAG-0004 v3 quote: the decision backends sc-decision-systemone, sc-decision-local and sc-decision-llm (over sc-llm-provider) form the layer between sc-decision-schema and sc-decision-runner.
ADR-SAG-0004 v3 approved fixtures (pass and fail), unchanged from v2.
phase-a-intent v1: low-level sc-agent libraries sc-agent-types, sc-decision-schema with the decision trait, and the shared HTTP layer.

item.title: Pin sc-agent-http dependencies
item.text: sc-agent-http depends only on sc-agent-types, sc-agent-secrets and sc-agent-log; no crate depends on sc-decision-runner.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture. It states a closed set of sc-agent dependencies for sc-agent-http, all in lower layers (types; secrets and log), and excludes dependence on the top-layer runner, so it states the restriction and nothing conflicts.

item.title: Let sc-agent-types name DecisionRequest
item.text: sc-agent-types adds sc-decision-schema to its [dependencies] so it can name DecisionRequest.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture. sc-agent-types is the bottom layer and sc-decision-schema is the decision-schema layer above it; the item adds a dependency the statement prohibits and does not state the restriction.

item.title: Create sc-decision-local
item.text: Create the sc-decision-local backend crate. Its Cargo.toml lists only sc-decision-schema and sc-agent-types as sc-agent dependencies, both in lower layers; it does not depend on sc-decision-runner or on any other backend.

cases.rationale: Paraphrased compliance: a backend crate depends only on the decision-schema and types layers below it and explicitly excludes the runner layer above it.

item.title: Shared session ID in log records
item.text: Add sc-agent-types as a dependency of sc-agent-log so log records can carry the shared SessionId type.

cases.rationale: Adds an sc-agent crate dependency (in scope). sc-agent-log (config/secrets/log layer) depending on sc-agent-types (bottom layer) is a downward dependency, so nothing conflicts; the item says nothing about the layering restriction, so it does not state it. Prohibition gating ignores the compliance role.

item.title: Layer diagram
item.text: Draw a diagram of the sc-agent crate layers, from sc-agent-types at the bottom to sc-decision-runner at the top, for the architecture overview.

cases.rationale: Mentions the layering topic but adds or changes no Cargo.toml dependency, which is the anchor's scope; the prohibition does not govern documentation work.

item.title: HTTP status in log records
item.text: Make sc-agent-log depend on sc-agent-http so log records can include the HTTP status type.

cases.rationale: sc-agent-log is in the config/secrets/log layer and sc-agent-http is the layer above it, so this upward dependency is prohibited.

item.title: Config parser error tests
item.text: Write unit tests for the TOML parse error messages produced by sc-agent-config.

cases.rationale: Test work inside one crate; no Cargo.toml dependency is added or changed.

item.title: Secrets reads config
item.text: sc-agent-secrets adds sc-agent-config as a dependency to read the keychain service name.

cases.rationale: sc-agent-config and sc-agent-secrets are in the same layer (config, secrets and log); the statement prohibits only dependencies on a higher layer, so a same-layer dependency does not conflict. The item does not state the restriction.

item.title: Temporary schema dependency
item.text: As a documented temporary exception until the decision trait moves down a layer, sc-agent-http adds sc-decision-schema to its [dependencies].

cases.rationale: The statement allows no exception. sc-agent-http (http layer) depending on sc-decision-schema (decision-schema layer above it) is an upward dependency regardless of the temporary framing.

item.title: LLM backend uses provider crate
item.text: sc-decision-llm adds sc-llm-provider to its [dependencies] to call the model provider.

cases.rationale: v3 places sc-llm-provider in the decision-backends layer beneath sc-decision-llm ('sc-decision-llm over sc-llm-provider'), so sc-decision-llm depending on it is not a dependency on a higher layer. The item states no restriction.

item.title: HTTP retries via provider
item.text: sc-agent-http adds sc-llm-provider to its [dependencies] so it can reuse the provider's retry policy.

cases.rationale: v3 places sc-llm-provider in the decision-backends layer, which is above the http layer; sc-agent-http depending on it is an upward dependency the statement prohibits.
